top_signals.title: UniCredit CEO Plots Commerzbank Governance Overhaul
top_signals.summary:
UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel has pledged to overhaul Commerzbank’s governance soon, in a move that may pave the way for an effort to oust CEO Bettina Orlopp. 
Speaking to Bloomberg TV, Orcel said all regulatory approvals for the deal are expected by the end of November.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)
